text:
maria: Heads-up — GCP Marketplace PO got rejected by partner procurement. They say the PO/invoice we're sending doesn't include the tariff classification and the commercial warranty acceptance that GCP requires. Partner put the deal on hold.
jonathan: Can you paste the exact rejection note from the partner or GCP? Need the precise wording for legal.
maria: Copied from partner email:
\"Validation failed: missing fields [tariff_classification, commercial_warranty_ack]. Please include explicit warranty acceptance and tariff code on the invoice/PO to proceed.\"
kevin: Partner rep also messaged me — they can resubmit but need the PO in the GCP billing profile format. They flagged two required fields: `billing_account_id` and `legal_entity.country`. Also they want an explicit clause: \"Seller accepts GCP commercial warranty terms\" on the PO.
anna: Finance — we can add `billing_account_id` and country, but we need the partner's tax ID and full invoicing address to match their profile. Can someone ask partner for that now?
maria: I've asked; they're gathering TAX ID and org address. They also asked for the exact warranty language we want. Jonathan, can legal share the line we should accept?
jonathan: Draft redline for PO footer (short):
\"Seller (Redwood Inference) hereby acknowledges and accepts the commercial warranty terms as defined by Google Cloud Marketplace and agrees to be bound for goods/services supplied under this PO.\"
jonathan: If procurement insists on different wording, ask them to paste the required text. We shouldn't invent wording for marketplace legalese.
maria: Partner procurement asked if we accept a one-sentence warranty acknowledgement or need full contract attachment. They prefer to keep it in-PO.
kevin: Ops note — GCP billing validation will also check `tariff_classification` (HS code). Partner provided suggested HS: `8471.80.10` for software appliances; procurement wants us to confirm. Finance: can we add that on our side or do we need legal sign-off?
anna: Finance is OK to include tariff code per partner suggestion but want legal to confirm no unintended customs implications. Jonathan — ok to proceed with the HS code above?
jonathan: OK to include the suggested HS code in the PO metadata as long as it's only for billing/classification and doesn't change contract scope. Proceed.
maria: Timeline: partner needs resubmission by EOD tomorrow to keep launch date. Procurement escalated to their legal if we miss that.
kevin: I'm drafting the updated PO template. Will include fields: `billing_account_id`, `legal_entity.country`, `tariff_classification`, `commercial_warranty_ack` (exact text above), plus partner TAX ID placeholder.
maria: Pasting the sample PO snippet I'm going to send to partner for their TAX ID fill-in:
```json
{
  "po_number": "PO-78923",
  "billing_account_id": "A-123456",
  "legal_entity": {"country": "US"},
  "tariff_classification": "8471.80.10",
  "commercial_warranty_ack": "Seller (Redwood Inference) hereby acknowledges and accepts the commercial warranty terms as defined by Google Cloud Marketplace."
}
```
kevin: I'll also run it past marketplace-ops to ensure our format satisfies GCP ingestion. pinging @gcp-marketplace-bot for validation.
gcp-marketplace-bot: Automatic check: PO schema validation FAILED - missing `partner_tax_id` field. See details in the portal link: https://console.gcp.example/marketplace/validation/PO-78923
anna: Partner TAX ID is the blocker then. If they can't provide it by tomorrow we might need a temporary extension from the partner or move the launch window.
maria: Action items: (1) kevin: finalize PO template and send to partner (2) partner: provide TAX ID + org address (3) jonathan: quick sign-off on warranty text (4) anna: prepare finance billing mapping if TAX ID differs. Target: resubmit by EOD tomorrow.
kevin: on it. pinging partner now in thread. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jonathan: I'll be on standby to approve final wording.
maria: thanks all — will update the thread when partner replies. :thumbsup:
